title: Spec: document RX staging ring in appendix-bufferbloat.md
description: Add section to spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md documenting the RX staging ring as an exception to single-buffer RX policy. Explain rationale: fragment reassembly is the one case where a drop wastes O(N) prior airtime, not O(1). Specify ring size 2-3 entries, FIFO overflow, not configurable. Verify: spec renders correctly in markdown.
